messages:
Ana (Docs): quick heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 to consolidate Private/VPC install notes (networking, KMS/HSM, air-gapped). please skim for glaring omissions.

Mike (Infra): thanks — pinged. I’ll check the VPC subnet/route examples. can we add an example for cross-az SG and NACLs? many customers ask about that. :thinking_face:

Ravi (Security): I’ll review KMS/HSM sections. ensure we call out envelope keys and CMK rotation procedure. also need a sample IAM policy for the private control plane to access keys.

Cheng (Install): re air-gapped install — I pushed a draft script in the PR but it’s pretty rough. it downloads images to a tarball and copies over. want help validating the steps against our on-prem puppet recipe.

Ana (Docs): perfect — prioritize: (1) networking diagrams + SG/NACL snippet (Mike) (2) KMS/HSM policy + rotation notes (Ravi) (3) air-gapped installer script + checklist (Cheng). I’ll update the migration guide section and add a short FAQ.

Mike (Infra): RG — adding a small snippet for SGs. would this work for most setups?

Mike (Infra): ```
# allow control-plane management from admin subnet
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-ctrl --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 10.0.5.0/24
# allow model traffic between nodes
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-nodes --protocol tcp --port 3100-3200 --source-group sg-nodes
```

Ravi (Security): looks good as an example. for HSM/KMS: add note that HSM-backed CMKs may have quotas and require CSR provisioning. also recommend a key policy like: "\"Statement\": [{\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodControlPlane\"},\"Action\":\"kms:Encrypt\"}]"

Cheng (Install): re script: I put a short checklist at the top of the draft:

Cheng (Install): ```
# air-gapped preflight checklist
- ensure all required images are mirrored to local registry
- ensure DNS entries for control plane are resolvable via local DNS
- sync time across nodes (chronyd)
- import CMK certs into HSM before install
```

Ana (Docs): nice: can we make the checklist a collapsible note in the final docs (short + link to full runbook)? also add a troubleshooting subsection for common failures (registry creds, time skew).

Mike (Infra): small nit: in networking section we should recommend MTU >= 1500 for gRPC streaming. add a sentence.

Ravi (Security): added a short HSM caution: "If using third-party HSMs, validate PKCS#11 compatibility and test unwrap/rewrap flows." also left inline comments on the PR for the rotation script.

Cheng (Install): FYI the deploy preview failed once for missing `config.yaml` in the airgap example. docs-bot shows build error: https://deploy-preview/docs/412 — the staging build logs mention `FileNotFoundError: examples/airgap/config.yaml`.

docs-bot: :robot_face: build failed for PR #412 — logs at https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/2981 (error: examples/airgap/config.yaml missing).

Ana (Docs): thanks — I’ll add a minimal `config.yaml` example and ensure examples are bundled in the PR.

Mike (Infra): can someone add a small network diagram image? I can draft a quick SVG and attach.

Ravi (Security): also add a security checklist item to rotate CMKs on role change and to audit HSM access logs monthly. small paragraph should do.

Cheng (Install): I pushed a fix for the missing config.yaml and updated the script to verify local registry auth before import. PR now says 5 files changed.

Ana (Docs): excellent. I’ll run a final pass tomorrow morning for tone + step ordering. if no objections, we merge after CI passes. tagging @Mike @Ravi @Cheng to confirm blocking issues.

Mike (Infra): LGTM after my SG/MTU suggestions are in.

Ravi (Security): LGTM for security content, please add key rotation snippet and link to our internal KMS playbook.

Cheng (Install): LGTM on air-gap flow. I’ll follow up with a separate RFC for fully offline bootstrap later.

Ana (Docs): thanks all :heart: — leaving one last cosmetic comment on wording. CI shows new build queued.

docs-bot: build succeeded for PR #412 — preview at https://deploy-preview/docs/412/ (expires in 7 days). :tada:

Ana (Docs): merging once you ack the tiny wording fix, will send short heads-up to #product about the updated Private install docs.

Mike (Infra): acked.

Ravi (Security): acked.

Cheng (Install): acked.
